summary: Input files and URLs are hidden dynamic dependencies
user_or_scientific_risk: In-place input changes may not invalidate raw_inputs, so a run can reuse stale target state
recommendation: Make adapter outputs explicit file-or-content-addressed targets; record input identity and hashes before validation

summary: Run directory identity is mutable and differs from manifest run_id
user_or_scientific_risk: Default latest can overwrite a prior run and the two run identifiers can disagree
recommendation: Create immutable content-addressed or generated run directories and update latest only as a replaceable pointer

summary: No fail-soft module status envelope
user_or_scientific_risk: One unsuitable or unavailable analysis can stop the whole run; users cannot see omitted prerequisites or remediation
recommendation: Add capability assessment and completed/completed_with_warnings/omitted/failed result envelopes around modules

summary: The four-table schema requires Judbury-specific covariates and traits
user_or_scientific_risk: Otherwise valid projects cannot use a small core and progressively unlock capability
recommendation: Retain a compatibility adapter while designing a versioned minimal internal core and optional metadata extensions

summary: Input selection and labelling provenance are absent
user_or_scientific_risk: Reports cannot distinguish all media from animal-only or selected-taxa extracts or assess classifier/human verification limits
recommendation: Preserve selection scope, confidence, verification, labelling method, model and annotator metadata when supplied

summary: No immutable raw snapshot or repair ledger
user_or_scientific_risk: Filtering and normalization are not reconstructable as previewed and approved changes linked to source rows
recommendation: Add immutable ingest snapshots, stable source-row IDs, three repair policy levels and a before/after approval ledger

summary: Location deployment interval and analysis site are collapsed
user_or_scientific_risk: Relocations, swaps and interval-specific effort/covariates cannot be represented without biased aggregation
recommendation: Introduce distinct internal location, deployment and named analysis-site entities while preserving current site adapter

summary: Unknown or failed operation cannot be represented
user_or_scientific_risk: The 0/1 no-NA matrix can turn uncertainty into false zero effort or force destructive imputation
recommendation: Use explicit observed-operating, observed-not-operating and unknown semantics with evidence and uncertainty

summary: Occupancy runs unconditionally on the nine-location Judbury design
user_or_scientific_risk: Small-site and all-zero fits can look inferential despite weak identifiability and known boundary warnings
recommendation: Default Judbury occupancy to omitted or illustrative-only through an objective design/fit eligibility gate

summary: Trait-environment correlations run without a design eligibility gate
user_or_scientific_risk: Many correlations over nine locations remain unstable even with FDR and may invite ecological over-interpretation
recommendation: Retain outputs as optional exploratory diagnostics and omit from the primary Judbury evidence profile by default

summary: Beta diversity supports descriptive distance-decay only
user_or_scientific_risk: Users may over-read analysis-ID pairs as physical-location turnover or a point relationship as covariate inference
recommendation: Retain the calculation but label it illustrative until the 13 IDs map to nine locations; defer multivariable spatial inference

summary: Every supported entrypoint requires R or shell knowledge
user_or_scientific_risk: Agency and NGO users cannot run data plus configuration without installing and operating the R toolchain
recommendation: After Goal 003 choose a thin launcher that drives the same engine and exposes validation and run progress

summary: Primary report audit detail and exploratory results are combined
user_or_scientific_risk: Decision-relevant findings are diluted and technical diagnostics are not a distinct reusable audit bundle
recommendation: Produce a concise primary evidence report plus detailed audit bundle and machine-readable result index

summary: Architecture and reference documents drift from implementation
user_or_scientific_risk: Users encounter target-state filenames and a detection-history schema still labelled planned
recommendation: Regenerate durable module and contract references from accepted architecture decisions

summary: No explicit LocalMap_Tas interchange or provenance contract
user_or_scientific_risk: GIS responsibilities can be duplicated and Tasmania-specific assumptions can leak into the engine
recommendation: Adopt the candidate file-plus-manifest boundary in localmap_boundary.md without code dependency or repository merger

summary: Remote CamtrapDP input is an implicit network operation
user_or_scientific_risk: Offline runs and reruns can fail or change when a URL changes; content identity is not recorded
recommendation: Separate acquisition from analysis and cache a validated package with URL, timestamp and checksum provenance

summary: Manifest lacks input hashes module states and repair lineage
user_or_scientific_risk: A completed manifest cannot prove which source bytes, warnings, omissions or approved repairs produced results
recommendation: Version a run manifest envelope containing input inventory, engine/profile versions, module states, repairs and artefact hashes

summary: Five profiles duplicate unversioned settings
user_or_scientific_risk: Defaults can drift between examples and a report cannot name the ecological evidence profile used
recommendation: Separate versioned named profiles from dataset-specific values and resolve them to one recorded configuration

summary: The DAG mixes engine computation rendering export and repository maintenance
user_or_scientific_risk: A 130-target monolith makes capability omission, reuse and interface integration harder
recommendation: Refactor later around ingest, validation, core model, capability modules and publishers sharing typed contracts

summary: Operational events do not expose a durable source-row linkage contract
user_or_scientific_risk: Reviewers cannot reliably trace an event and applied filtering back to immutable input records
recommendation: Assign stable source IDs and event IDs and publish an event-to-source membership table

summary: Operational clusters are called independent events
user_or_scientific_risk: Users may mistake a configurable repeat-detection rule for independent animals or biological observations
recommendation: Use operational detection event in public outputs and reserve biological independence claims

summary: Interpolated geographic-degree surface is visual context only
user_or_scientific_risk: A visually smooth surface from nine points could be mistaken for measured environmental coverage
recommendation: Retain only as clearly labelled context or replace with LocalMap-supplied measured covariates/maps

summary: No named grouped-site spatial resolutions or temporal schemes
user_or_scientific_risk: Results cannot state whether inference is at location grouped site whole grid deployment or a named occasion scheme
recommendation: Represent named versioned spatial resolutions and temporal schemes selected and reported per module

summary: ALA and gamma-diversity context are absent
user_or_scientific_risk: The desired regional comparison cannot yet be produced and its biases are unrepresented
recommendation: Keep as a candidate extension pending Goal 003 and explicit scale taxonomy detectability and opportunistic-bias rules

summary: Optional AI interpretation boundary is absent
user_or_scientific_risk: Future additions could blur computed results and interpretation or cause unreviewed data egress
recommendation: Do not add AI now; Goal 003 should compare provider-pluggable downstream patterns and egress disclosures

summary: Disabled features emit placeholder files rather than omitted results
user_or_scientific_risk: A file exists without a structured prerequisite consequence or remediation record
recommendation: Replace placeholders as status evidence with structured omitted results while retaining human-readable notices

summary: There is no opinionated versioned standard evidence profile
user_or_scientific_risk: All analyses run from dataset profiles and guided/advanced modes cannot share a stable product contract
recommendation: Define a technology-neutral standard profile with capability prerequisites and the same resolved config for all modes

summary: A full pipeline run can rewrite a tracked data dictionary
user_or_scientific_risk: Scientific execution has a hidden repository mutation side effect unrelated to a run bundle
recommendation: Move dictionary generation to an explicit maintenance command or write a run-scoped read-only consistency result
